# Truegle

> Truegle is an independent, privacy-first search engine built on radical transparency. We surface multiple perspectives on every query — political, cultural, scientific, and alternative — without algorithmic suppression or tracking.

## What Truegle Is

Truegle is a search engine that does not filter, bias, or suppress results based on institutional preferences. Our mission is to give every user a flashlight into the corners of the internet that mainstream search engines actively avoid indexing or ranking. We believe knowledge should not be gatekept by institutions, governments, or corporate interests.

## Core Principles

- No user tracking, no cookies, no hidden data collection
- Multiple perspectives shown for every query — mainstream and alternative
- AI-powered summaries that present facts without editorial bias
- Ad revenue shared with users (coming soon)
- Privacy as a feature, not a policy checkbox

## Key Features

- Universal search across web, images, video, maps, social, news, and shopping
- AI quick-answer cards for direct questions
- OSINT tools for independent investigators
- Social media search with embedded posts (no login required)
- Map search with local business discovery
- Dark-mode first, mobile-friendly interface

## Who This Is For

People who are tired of algorithmic bubbles. Researchers who need access to suppressed or alternative sources. Privacy-conscious users who refuse to be tracked. Independent thinkers who want to see the full picture, not the curated one.
